tools.name: company-intelligence_search
tools.description: Search companies by name and country using the GLEIF LEI database. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/company-intelligence/search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: company-intelligence_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a company profile using LEI from GLEIF. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/company-intelligence/profile. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: company-intelligence_ownership
tools.description: Retrieve parent and subsidiary relationships from GLEIF. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/company-intelligence/ownership. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: company-intelligence_financials
tools.description: Retrieve and normalize financial metrics from SEC EDGAR using CIK or ticker. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/company-intelligence/financials. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: company-intelligence_filings
tools.description: Retrieve recent company filings and significant changes from SEC EDGAR using CIK or ticker. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/company-intelligence/filings. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: company-intelligence_vat-id-lookup
tools.description: Validate a supplied EU VAT ID with VIES and/or search GLEIF by company name for official registration numbers. Does not invent a VAT ID when VIES has none, and does not call UK Companies House. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/company-intelligence/vat-id-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "company-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: company-intelligence_search, company-intelligence_profile, company-intelligence_ownership, company-intelligence_financials, company-intelligence_filings, company-intelligence_vat-id-lookup · Private data: company-intelligence_search · Public sink: company-intelligence_search, company-intelligence_profile, company-intelligence_ownership, company-intelligence_financials, company-intelligence_filings, company-intelligence_vat-id-lookup · Destructive: company-intelligence_search, company-intelligence_profile, company-intelligence_ownership, company-intelligence_financials, company-intelligence_filings, company-intelligence_vat-id-lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: company-intelligence_search, company-intelligence_profile, company-intelligence_ownership, company-intelligence_financials, company-intelligence_filings, company-intelligence_vat-id-lookup · Private data: company-intelligence_search · Public sink: company-intelligence_search, company-intelligence_profile, company-intelligence_ownership, company-intelligence_financials, company-intelligence_filings, company-intelligence_vat-id-lookup · Destructive: company-intelligence_search, company-intelligence_profile, company-intelligence_ownership, company-intelligence_financials, company-intelligence_filings, company-intelligence_vat-id-lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
